questions.question:

He is a young man about twenty-five years but very learned.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**about twenty-five years**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the fourth segment of the sentence, the word '**years**' is not correct.
 
• Here, the word '**years**' should be replaced with the word '**year**'. It is not used as a **noun **so we cannot use the plural form of this word**.**
 
• The word **'year**' is a part of the grouping of three words, i.e. '**twenty-five-year**'. It acts like an **adjective**.
 
• Hence, **option 4)** is the answer.

**Correct sentence**: *He is a young man about twenty-five-year but very learned*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

A **singular noun** is used with a **cardinal adjective**. These words should be added with hyphens.

__
 
• **Example**__: *She has a twenty-rupee note*.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I wish to travel the whole world, but I______afford it.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**can’t**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**should'** is used to express 'duty or obligation'. '**shouldn't or should not**' is used to indicate what one must not do.

 
 
• **Example**__: *You shouldn't quarrel with your friends*.
 
 
 
• '**would**' is used to express an imagined situation or action. '**wouldn't**' is used to form a negative sentence.
 __
 
• **Example**__: *She wouldn't buy this house*.
 
 
 
• '**won't**' is the contraction of '**will not**' and it is used to express future events.
 __
 
• **Example**__: *He won't come here*.
 
 
 
• '**can't**' is used to express '__not able__'.
 __
 
• **Example**__: *She can't read*.
 
• In the given sentence the conjunction '**but**' is indicating that one is unable to do something. Hence, '**can't**' is the best fit.
 
 
 
• Therefore, **option 3)** is the answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• '**should'** का प्रयोग 'कर्तव्य या दायित्व' को व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है. '**shouldn't or should not**' यह इंगित करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है कि किसी को क्या नहीं करना चाहिए।

 
 
• उदाहरण: आपको अपने दोस्तों से झगड़ा नहीं करना चाहिए।
 
 
 
• '**would**' किसी कल्पित स्थिति या क्रिया को व्यक्त करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। '**wouldn't**' एक नकारात्मक वाक्य बनाने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है।
 
 
• उदाहरण: वह यह घर नहीं खरीदेगी।
 
 
 
• '**won't**' '**will not**' का संकुचन है और इसका उपयोग भविष्य की घटनाओं को व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है।
 
 
• उदाहरण: वह यहाँ नहीं आएगा ।
 
 
 
• '**can't**' 'सक्षम नहीं' व्यक्त करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है।
 
 
• उदाहरण: वह पढ़ नहीं सकती।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में संयोजन '**but**' यह दर्शाता है कि कोई कुछ करने में असमर्थ है। इसलिए, '**can't**' सबसे उपयुक्त है।
 
 
 
• इसलिए, **option 3)** उत्तर है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• A **modal auxiliary verb** is used to express possibility or necessity__. '**can**', '**must**', '**may**' etc. are modal **auxiliary verb**.

 __
 
• **Example:** Can__ she do it?

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

The terrain of India__ is make of __mountains, plateaus and plains.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'is made of'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb 'make' is incorrect. Hence, the underlined segment should be replaced.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject(The terrain of India) is acted upon. Hence, the sentence should be written in 'passive voice'.
 
• In passive voice, 'V3' is used after the auxiliary verb.
 
• So, the Verb1, i.e. 'make' should be replaced with the Verb3 form i.e. 'made'.
 
• Hence, option 2) is the correct answer.

Correct sentence__: *The terrain of India __is made of__ mountains, plateaus, and plains*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 

__
 
• क्रिया 'make' गलत है। इसलिए, रेखांकित खंड को प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में, विषय (The terrain of India) पर कार्रवाई की गई है। अतः वाक्य को ' निष्क्रिय स्वर ' में लिखा जाना चाहिए।
 
• निष्क्रिय स्वर में सहायक क्रिया के बाद 'V3' का प्रयोग होता है।
 
• तो, Verb1, यानी ' make' को Verb3 रूप यानी 'made' से प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• अत: विकल्प 2) सही उत्तर है।

सही वाक्य__: *The terrain of India __is made of__ mountains, plateaus, and plains*.

questions.question:
**From the given options, identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

My sister tried to tempt me with sweets so that I ought not tell our parents about the vase she broke.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option (2). '**ought not tell'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**ought not tell'** is not grammatically correct.
 
• The preposition '**to**' is used with the **modal verb** '**ought**' which expresses obligation or duty__.
 __
 
• **Example**__: *We ought not to laugh at the poor boy*.
 
• Hence, '**to**' should be used before the word **'tell**'.
 
• So, the correct answer is **option 2)**.
 
 

__**Correct sentence**__: *My sister tried to tempt me with sweets so that I **ought not to tell** our parents about the vase she broke*.

 __
 
• Example__: *Most of the students were present*.

questions.question:
**From the given options, identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

I know the most easiest way to solve this problem.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**most easiest**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **second segment** is erroneous.
 
• The word '**easiest**' is the **superlative degree** of the adjective '**easy**'.
 
• So, '**most**' should not be used with this word.
 
• Hence, **option 2)** is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence**__:* I know the easiest way to solve this problem.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** *

__
 
• **दूसरा खंड** गलत है।
 
• '**easiest**' शब्द विशेषण '**easy**' का अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण अंश है।
 
• अतः इस शब्द के साथ **'most'** का प्रयोग नहीं करना चाहिए।
 
• अत: **option 2)** सही उत्तर है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• An **adjective** modifies a noun or a pronoun.

 
 
• **Example__**: *Testbook is an amazing online learning platform*.
 
 
 
• **Adjectives** have **three** different **forms of degrees** to show comparison: **positive degree**, **comparative degree**, **superlative degree**.
 
• **Positive degree**: Positive degree is used to describe a **noun** and when there is no comparison. 
 __
 
• **Example__**: *Lily is a good girl*.
 
 
 
• **Comparative degree**: Comparative degree is used when two things or persons or objects are__ compared with each other.__
 __
 
• **Example__**: *Lily is taller than Rahul*.
 
 
 
• **Superlative degree**: Superlative degree is used when more than two persons or things or objects are compared.
 __
 
• **Example__**: *Lily is the tallest girl in the class*.
